steps: The Hobbing Machine performs hobbing on a broached component to create a hobbied gear, operating at a speed of 150 rpm with a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev and an involute gear profile, for 1 minute.

The Horizontal Milling Machine performs a Milling operation for 32 minutes on a Milled Part taken from the ConveyorBelt, using a helical tool path at a speed of 2000 rpm to achieve a surface finish of Ra 0.8, resulting in a Finished Machined Component placed on the MobileRobot.

Using a Grinding Machine, the Planed Part from the Conveyor Belt is ground into a Ground Part for 15 minutes with an Aluminum Oxide grinding wheel at a wheel speed of 3000 rpm and a feed rate of 0.02 mm/rev.

Using a Wire EDM (Electrical Discharge Machine) for 15 minutes, the Shaped Part from the Conveyor Belt is precisely cut into a Precision Finished Part with parameters set to 50V, 10A, a brass wire, and a cutting speed of 6 mm/min, which is then placed on a Mobile Robot.
Using a Horizontal Lathe, a Metal Bar is turned into a Lathed Part for 72 minutes with a rotation speed of 1200 rpm, a carbide insert tool, and a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev.
Using a Drill Press, a Metal Bar is drilled for 41 minutes with a 10 mm drill bit at a spindle speed of 800 rpm and a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev to produce a Drilled Component.

The Shaper machine performs the Shaping operation on a Milled Part taken from the ConveyorBelt, transforming it into a Shaped Part and placing it back on the ConveyorBelt, using a Single Point tool with a stroke length of 100 mm and a shaping speed of 20 strokes/min, for a duration of 49 minutes.
Using a Gear Shaper for 17 minutes, the operation shapes a 24-tooth spur gear at a speed of 15 rpm, transforming a broached component into a shaped gear, both transported via a conveyor belt.

Using Stewart Platform Mills, the Precision Milling operation transforms a Milled Part into a Ground Part in 12 minutes, employing a Ball Nose tool, achieving a milling precision of 0.01 mm with active vibration damping.

The Honing Machine performs honing operation on a Honed Cylinder from the ConveyorBelt for 39 minutes using a 600 grit size, 30-second cycle time, and 25 mm bore size to produce a Precision Finished Part, which is then placed on a MobileRobot.

Using a Broaching Machine, the metal bar is subjected to surface broaching with a feed rate of 0.05 mm/rev and a depth of cut of 0.5 mm for 66 minutes, transforming it into a broached component that is then placed on the conveyor belt.

The CNC Turning operation, performed on a CNC Turning Center for 64 minutes with a spindle speed of 1500 rpm, tool offsets of X:0.1 and Z:0.05, and using the G-Code program, transforms a Lathed Part from the ConveyorBelt into a Finished Machined Component placed on the MobileRobot.

The Vertical Milling Machine performs Vertical Milling on a Lathed Part for 10 minutes at a milling speed of 1800 rpm using an End Mill with a depth of cut of 5 mm to produce a Milled Part, with both components handled via the ConveyorBelt.
The bandsaw performs sawing on a metal bar for 24 minutes using a bimetal blade at a speed of 50 m/min and a cutting width of 3 mm, transforming it into a lathed part.

The Planer performs the Planing operation on a Milled Part for 60 minutes, using a planing depth of 2 mm, a feed rate of 0.3 mm/rev, and achieving a surface finish of Ra 1.6, resulting in a Planed Part placed on the ConveyorBelt.

Using a Punch Press, punching is performed on Sheet Metal from the ConveyorBelt for 76 minutes with a punch size of 12 mm, a stroke speed of 40 strokes/min, and a die alignment of 0.01 mm, resulting in a Finished Sheet Metal Product placed on a MobileRobot.

Using a Vertical Lathe, perform Vertical Turning on a Metal Bar for 72 minutes at a rotation speed of 1000 rpm, a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev, and with a Carbide Insert tool, transforming the input into a Lathed Part.

The Screwing operation on Screw Machines transforms a Lathed Part from the ConveyorBelt into a Screwed Component using an M8 Metric screw at a production rate of 50 parts/hour, taking 47 minutes to complete.

The Shearing operation is performed on the Sheet Metal using a Shear (Sheet Metal) machine for 99 minutes, with a shear angle of 3 degrees, a cutting speed of 20 m/min, and a standard blade type, transforming the Sheet Metal into Sheared Sheet Metal, which is then placed on the ConveyorBelt.

The Laser Cutter performs Laser Cutting on Sheet Metal for 92 minutes using a laser power of 2000 W, a cutting speed of 10 mm/s, and nitrogen gas assist, transforming it into Cut Sheet Metal, which is then placed on the conveyor belt.
The Gear Shaping operation shapes a Broached Gear Blank into a 24-tooth Spur Gear using a Gear Shaper at a shaping speed of 120 RPM for 28 minutes, producing a Shaped Gear.

The Punch Press performs a punching operation on raw sheet metal, using a 10 mm punch size, a stroke speed of 30 strokes per minute, and a die alignment of 0.05 mm, transforming it into a punched sheet metal product in 62 minutes.
The Vertical Milling Machine performs Vertical Milling on a Turning Blank for 64 minutes using an End Mill at 500 RPM with a depth of cut of 2 mm, transforming it into a Milled Gear Blank.
Using a Grinding Machine with an Aluminum Oxide grinding wheel at 1800 RPM and a feed rate of 0.02 mm/pass, the Planed Gear Blank is ground into a Ground Gear Blank for 95 minutes.

The Planer performs a planing operation on a Milled Gear Blank for 94 minutes, achieving a planing depth of 1 mm, a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev, and a surface finish of Ra 1.6, transforming it into a Planed Gear Blank.

Using a Broaching Machine for 86 minutes, the metal bar stock is transformed into a broached gear blank through a pull-type broaching operation with a feed rate of 0.05 mm/rev and a depth of cut of 3 mm.

The operation removes material from the Broached Gear Blank using a Hobbing Machine for 87 minutes at a hobbing speed of 100 RPM and a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev to produce a Hobbied Gear with an involute profile.
Using a Vertical Lathe, the Metal Bar Stock is vertically turned into a Lathed Gear Blank for 11 minutes at a rotation speed of 800 RPM, a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev, and using a Carbide Insert tool.

The Honing Machine performs the Honing operation on a Honed Cylinder from the ConveyorBelt for 46 minutes using a 320 grit size, a 5-minute cycle time, and a 50 mm bore size to produce a Precision Finished Cylinder, which is then placed back on the ConveyorBelt.
The Laser Cutter performs Laser Cutting on Raw Sheet Metal for 64 minutes using a laser power of 2 kW, a cutting speed of 1 m/min, and nitrogen gas assist, transforming it into Laser Cut Sheet Metal.

Using a Stewart Platform Mills, the Milled Gear Blank undergoes Precision Milling for 86 minutes with a milling precision of 0.01 mm, a 5-axis tool configuration, and active vibration damping to produce a Ground Gear Blank.

The Shaper machine performs the Shaping operation on a Milled Gear Blank using a Single Point tool with a stroke length of 200 mm and a speed of 50 strokes per minute for 76 minutes, transforming it into a Shaped Gear Blank.

Using Screw Machines, perform Screw Machining on Lathed Gear Blanks from a ConveyorBelt to produce Screwed Gear Shafts with M8 metric threads at a production rate of 20 parts per minute for 11 minutes.

Using a Drill Press, drill a 10 mm hole in the Metal Bar Stock at a spindle speed of 500 RPM and a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev for 32 minutes to produce a Drilled Gear Blank, which is then moved via a MobileRobot.

Using a Horizontal Milling Machine for 44 minutes, the Horizontal Milling operation transforms a Milled Gear Blank into a Finished Machined Gear, milling at 600 RPM with a Contour tool path to achieve a surface finish of Ra 0.8, with both input and output components placed on a ConveyorBelt.

The CNC Turning operation transforms a Lathed Gear Blank into a Finished Machined Gear on a CNC Turning Center using CNC program G02, a tool offset of 0.01 mm, and a spindle speed of 1000 RPM, which takes 31 minutes.

Using a Shear (Sheet Metal) machine, the operation of Shearing cuts Raw Sheet Metal into Sheared Sheet Metal for 77 minutes at a shear angle of 2 degrees and a cutting speed of 0.5 m/min with a Straight blade type.

Using a Wire EDM (Electrical Discharge Machine) with parameters set to 100 V, 10 A, a brass wire, and a cutting speed of 1 mm/min, the shaped gear blank is precision machined into a precision finished gear for 99 minutes.

A Horizontal Lathe performs Horizontal Turning on a Metal Bar Stock for 16 minutes using a Rotation speed of 700 RPM, a Carbide Insert tool, and a Feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev to produce a Lathed Gear Blank, which is then placed in a MobileRobot.
The Bandsaw Cutting operation uses a Bimetal blade to cut Metal Bar Stock into Lathed Gear Blanks at a saw speed of 50 m/min and a cutting width of 3 mm, taking 97 minutes to complete on the Bandsaw.

A horizontal lathe performs a turning operation for 78 minutes on a metal bar using a carbide insert tool with a rotation speed of 1200 rpm and a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev, transforming it into a lathed part, which is then placed on a conveyor belt.

The Gear Shaping operation shapes a broached component into a 24-tooth spur gear using a Gear Shaper for 28 minutes at a shaping speed of 10 strokes per minute, with the broached component delivered by a MobileRobot and the resulting shaped gear placed on a ConveyorBelt.

The shearing operation, performed on the Shear (Sheet Metal) machine for 2 minutes, cuts sheet metal from the conveyor belt into sheared sheet metal using a straight blade at a cutting speed of 20 m/min and a shear angle of 88 degrees, placing the output back onto the conveyor belt.

The Planer machine performs a Planing operation on a Milled part for 3 minutes, with a Planing depth of 0.1 mm, a Feed rate of 50 mm/min, and a Surface finish of Ra 0.8, transforming the input Milled part into a Planed part.

The Broaching Machine performs broaching using a pull broach to achieve IT7 precision level, transforming the lathed part into a broached component in 88 minutes, with the input delivered by a MobileRobot and the output placed on a ConveyorBelt.
Using a Shaper machine for 69 minutes, the Milled part is shaped into a Shaped part with a stroke length of 200 mm, a shaping speed of 15 strokes per minute, and a high-speed steel tool.

The bandsaw performs sawing on a metal bar placed on the conveyor belt for 34 minutes at a speed of 100 m/min using a variable pitch blade, producing a lathed part with a cutting width of 3 mm, which is then placed back on the conveyor belt.

The hobbing operation shapes a broached component into a hobbied gear using a hobbing machine for 99 minutes, with a hobbing speed of 100 rpm, a feed rate of 2 mm/min, and an involute gear profile, transferring the component from a MobileRobot to a ConveyorBelt.
Using Screw Machines, perform Thread Cutting on a Lathed part to produce a Screwed component with an M10 screw size and Metric thread type at a production rate of 50 pcs/hour, lasting for 33 minutes.
Using a Drill Press for 70 minutes, the metal bar is drilled into a drilled component with an 8 mm drill size, a spindle speed of 1500 rpm, and a feed rate of 0.15 mm/rev.

The Punch Press performs the Punching operation on sheet metal from the conveyor belt for 18 minutes, using a 10 mm punch, a stroke speed of 30 strokes/min, and centered die alignment, to produce the finished sheet metal product on the conveyor belt.

The Grinding operation processes a Planed part into a Ground part on Grinding Machines for 22 minutes using an Aluminum oxide grinding wheel at a wheel speed of 2000 rpm and a feed rate of 0.05 mm/pass.

The Honing Machine performs the honing operation on a honed cylinder using a 220 grit size honing tool, with a cycle time of 2 minutes and a bore size of 50 mm, processing the component for 41 minutes to produce a precision finished part.

The CNC Turning operation transforms a lathed part into a finished machined component using a CNC Turning Center for 20 minutes, employing a custom CNC program, auto-calibrated tool offsets, and a spindle speed of 2500 rpm, with the input material delivered by a MobileRobot and the output product transported via a ConveyorBelt.

Using a Stewart Platform Mills, the operation performs Milling on a Milled part taken from a ConveyorBelt to produce a Ground part placed back on the ConveyorBelt, lasting for 21 minutes with a precision of ±0.01 mm, an End mill tool configuration, and active vibration damping.

The Vertical Milling Machine performs a milling operation on a lathed part, transported by a MobileRobot, for 44 minutes using a carbide end mill at a speed of 3000 rpm and a depth of cut of 1.5 mm, resulting in a milled part placed on a ConveyorBelt.

The Laser Cutter performs Laser Cutting on sheet metal from the conveyor belt for 66 minutes at 2000 W laser power and 1.5 m/min cutting speed with Nitrogen gas assist, producing cut sheet metal that is placed back on the conveyor belt.

The Horizontal Milling Machine performs a Milling operation on the Milled part from the ConveyorBelt for 18 minutes at a speed of 2500 rpm using a Contour tool path to achieve a surface finish of Ra 0.4, resulting in the Finished machined component placed back on the ConveyorBelt.

The Wire EDM (Electrical Discharge Machine) performs a Wire EDM operation for 73 minutes, using brass wire with electrical parameters set to 30 A and 100 V and a cutting speed of 10 mm/min, to transform a shaped part from a mobile robot into a precision finished part placed on a conveyor belt.

Perform turning on a Vertical Lathe for 80 minutes, using a ceramic insert tool at a rotation speed of 1000 rpm and a feed rate of 0.25 mm/rev, to transform a metal bar from the conveyor belt into a lathed part placed back onto the conveyor belt.

Using a Drill Press for 20 minutes, a 10mm drill is used at a spindle speed of 1200 RPM and a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev to transform a metal bar into a drilled component, with both the input and output remaining on the conveyor belt.

The Punch Press performs the Punching operation for 22 minutes, using a 15mm punch at a stroke speed of 30 strokes/min with a die alignment of 0.1mm, transforming sheet metal on a conveyor belt into a finished sheet metal product on the same conveyor belt.

The Shaper machine performs the Shaping operation on a Milled part for 76 minutes using a Carbide cutter with a stroke length of 100mm and a shaping speed of 10m/min, transforming it into a Shaped part, both of which are handled on a ConveyorBelt.
Using a Vertical Lathe, a metal bar is turned into a lathed part for 43 minutes at a rotation speed of 1500 RPM, a feed rate of 0.3 mm/rev, and with a carbide insert tool.

Using Screw Machines, perform Threading on a Lathed part from the ConveyorBelt to create a Screwed component with an M12 screw size and Metric thread type at a production rate of 120 parts/hour, lasting for 60 minutes.

The Honing Machine performs honing on a honed cylinder from the conveyor belt for 91 minutes, using a 400 grit size honing tool and a 5-minute cycle time to produce a precision finished part with a 50mm bore size, which is then placed back on the conveyor belt.

Using a Wire EDM (Electrical Discharge Machine), the Wire Cutting operation transforms the Shaped part into a Precision finished part for 88 minutes, employing a Brass wire, a cutting speed of 6mm/min, and electrical parameters of 50V and 10A.

The sheet metal is subjected to a shearing operation using a Shear (Sheet Metal) machine for 26 minutes, where it is cut at a 2-degree shear angle with a cutting speed of 20m/min using a high-speed steel blade, transforming the input sheet metal into sheared sheet metal.
The Milling operation on a Vertical Milling Machine shapes the Lathed part into a Milled part using an End mill at 1000 RPM with a depth of cut of 2mm, and the process takes 12 minutes to complete.
The Hobbing Machine performs hobbing on a broached component for 8 minutes at a hobbing speed of 300 RPM, a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev, and an involute gear profile, transforming it into a hobbied gear.

The Gear Shaper performs the Gear Shaping operation on a broached component for 65 minutes, producing a shaped gear with parameters including a spur gear type, 24 teeth, and a shaping speed of 10m/min.

The bandsaw performs a sawing operation for 39 minutes, cutting a metal bar into a lathed part using a bi-metal blade at a speed of 40m/min with a cutting width of 2mm, transferring both the input and output components via the conveyor belt.

The CNC Turning Center performs CNC Turning for 49 minutes using a G-code program, tool offsets of 0.1mm, and a spindle speed of 2000 RPM to transform a lathed part into a finished machined component.

The Laser Cutter performs Laser Cutting on sheet metal from the conveyor belt for 83 minutes using a 2kW laser, a cutting speed of 10m/min, and nitrogen gas assist, resulting in cut sheet metal placed back on the conveyor belt.

The Horizontal Milling Machine performs Horizontal Milling on a Milled part from the ConveyorBelt for 30 minutes at 800 RPM with a Contour tool path to achieve a 0.8µm surface finish, producing a Finished machined component placed back on the ConveyorBelt.
The Broaching Machine performs internal broaching on a metal bar for 78 minutes using a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev and a depth of cut of 1mm, transforming it into a broached component.

The Stewart Platform Mills perform Precision Milling on a milled part taken from the conveyor belt for 21 minutes using a ball nose end mill with a precision of 0.01mm and active vibration damping, resulting in a ground part placed back on the conveyor belt.
The Planer machine performs Planing on a Milled part for 96 minutes at a depth of 1.5mm, a feed rate of 5m/min, and a surface finish of 1.6µm, transforming it into a Planed part.

The horizontal lathe performs horizontal turning on a metal bar for 6 minutes at a rotation speed of 1800 RPM using a carbide insert tool with a feed rate of 0.25 mm/rev, transforming it into a lathed part.
The Grinding operation uses Grinding Machines to process a Planed part into a Ground part for 56 minutes with an aluminum oxide grinding wheel at a wheel speed of 30m/s and a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev.

Using a Vertical Lathe, perform turning on a metal bar from the conveyor belt at 1200 rpm rotation speed, 0.1 mm/rev feed rate, and with a carbide insert tool for 56 minutes to produce a lathed part, which is then placed on a mobile robot.

Using a Shaper machine for 52 minutes, the Shaping operation transforms a Milled part from the ConveyorBelt into a Shaped part, which is then placed on a MobileRobot, with a stroke length of 150 mm, a shaping speed of 25 m/min, and a High-Speed Steel (HSS) tool.

The Threading operation, performed on Screw Machines for 73 minutes, processes a Lathed part from the ConveyorBelt into a Screwed component on the MobileRobot, using an M8 screw size, Metric thread type, and a production rate of 100 pcs/hr.

The Horizontal Milling Machine performs Finishing Milling on a milled part taken from the ConveyorBelt for 20 minutes at 2000 rpm milling speed with a linear tool path to achieve a surface finish of 0.8 µm, resulting in a finished machined component placed on the MobileRobot.

The sheet metal is sheared using a Shear (Sheet Metal) machine for 76 minutes at a shear angle of 2°, a cutting speed of 10 m/min, and with a straight blade, transforming the sheet metal on the conveyor belt into sheared sheet metal, which is then placed onto a mobile robot.

The Wire EDM Cutting operation uses a Wire EDM (Electrical Discharge Machine) to precisely cut a shaped part from the conveyor belt into a precision finished part, employing a brass wire, an electrical parameter of 100 V, and a cutting speed of 6 mm/min, completing the process for 73 minutes before transferring the output to a mobile robot.

The Gear Shaping operation shapes a broached component into a 24-tooth spur gear using a Gear Shaper for 21 minutes at a shaping speed of 30 m/min, with the input component sourced from a conveyor belt and the output shaped gear placed on a mobile robot.

A Hobbing Machine performs hobbing on a broached component from the conveyor belt, transforming it into a hobbied gear with a hobbing speed of 200 rpm, a feed rate of 1 mm/rev, and an involute gear profile, for 21 minutes, before transferring the output to a mobile robot.

Using a Laser Cutter, the Laser Cutting operation processes sheet metal from the conveyor belt into cut sheet metal at a laser power of 1500 W, a cutting speed of 1.5 m/min, and with nitrogen gas assist, taking 40 minutes, after which the cut sheet metal is placed onto a mobile robot.

The Punch Press performs the Punching operation on sheet metal from the conveyor belt for 69 minutes using a 10 mm punch size, a stroke speed of 30 strokes/min, and a die alignment of 0.1 mm to produce the finished sheet metal product, which is then placed on a mobile robot.

The Grinding operation uses Grinding Machines to grind a Planed part from the ConveyorBelt into a Ground part loaded onto a MobileRobot, utilizing an Aluminum oxide grinding wheel at a wheel speed of 1800 rpm and a feed rate of 0.05 mm/pass, and takes 19 minutes to complete.

The Honing Machine performs honing for 93 minutes, using a 320 grit size and a 5-minute cycle time to achieve a 50 mm bore size, transforming a HonedCylinder from the ConveyorBelt into a PrecisionFinishedPart delivered by the MobileRobot.

The Broaching Machine performs surface broaching on a metal bar from the conveyor belt for 92 minutes using a feed rate of 0.1 mm/stroke and a depth of cut of 0.5 mm, producing a broached component that is transferred to a mobile robot.

The Precision Milling operation is performed on the Stewart Platform Mills for 74 minutes, using an end mill with a milling precision of 0.01 mm and active vibration damping, to transform a milled part from the conveyor belt into a ground part placed on a mobile robot.
The Bandsaw Cutting operation cuts a Metal bar into a Lathed part using a Bandsaw for 88 minutes at a saw speed of 50 m/min with a Bi-metal blade and a cutting width of 2 mm.

The CNC Turning operation on a CNC Turning Center, using a G-code program, 0.02 mm tool offsets, and 1500 rpm spindle speed, processes a lathed part from the conveyor belt into a finished machined component placed on the mobile robot, taking 74 minutes.

The Horizontal Lathe performs a turning operation on a metal bar for 95 minutes at a rotation speed of 1000 rpm using a carbide insert tool with a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev to produce a lathed part, which is then transferred to a mobile robot.

A Vertical Milling Machine performs milling on a lathed part obtained from a conveyor belt for 43 minutes at a speed of 3000 rpm using an end mill with a depth of cut of 1 mm, producing a milled part that is placed onto a mobile robot.

The Drilling operation on the Drill Press machine, which uses an 8 mm drill at a spindle speed of 1200 rpm and a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev, processes a Metal bar into a Drilled component for 50 minutes, transferring the input from the ConveyorBelt and the output to the MobileRobot.

Perform Planing on a Planer for 77 minutes to transform a Milled part from the ConveyorBelt into a Planed part placed on a MobileRobot, using a planing depth of 0.5 mm, a feed rate of 0.2 mm/pass, and achieving a surface finish of 1.6 µm.
The Laser Cutter performs Laser Cutting on Sheet Metal for 79 minutes using a laser power of 500 W, a cutting speed of 20 mm/s, and nitrogen gas assist, producing Cut Sheet Metal.
Using a Horizontal Lathe, the metal bar undergoes turning at a rotation speed of 1200 rpm with a carbide tool and a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev for 57 minutes, resulting in a lathed part.

The CNC Turning Center performs CNC Turning on a lathed part loaded from the conveyor belt, using a preloaded CNC program, a tool offset of 0.01 mm, and a spindle speed of 1500 rpm, transforming it into a finished machined component on the conveyor belt in 70 minutes.
The Honing Machine performs honing on a Honed Cylinder using a 400 grit size, a 5 s cycle time, and a 50 mm bore size for 34 minutes, transforming the Honed Cylinder into a Precision Finished Part.

Grinding is performed on a Grinding Machine for 28 minutes using a diamond grinding wheel at 3000 rpm with a feed rate of 0.1 mm/pass, transforming a Planed Part from the conveyor belt into a Ground Part on the conveyor belt.

The Stewart Platform Mills perform a milling operation for 28 minutes, transforming a Milled Part into a Ground Part with a precision of 0.01 mm using an End Mill tool and active vibration damping, with both components transported via MobileRobot.

Using a Shaper machine for 84 minutes, the Milled Part is transformed into a Shaped Part through the Shaping operation with a stroke length of 50 mm, shaping speed of 10 strokes/min, and a Carbide tool, with both the input and output components being handled on a Conveyor Belt.

The sheet metal is sheared into sheared sheet metal using a Shear (Sheet Metal) machine for 40 minutes, with a shear angle of 2°, a cutting speed of 30 m/min, and a straight blade type, with both the input and output components transported via a MobileRobot.

Using a Broaching Machine for 6 minutes, the Lathed Part is transformed into a Broached Component by performing keyway broaching with a precision level of 0.05 mm, with both components being handled via a conveyor belt.
Using a Vertical Lathe, the Metal Bar is vertically turned into a Lathed Part for 53 minutes with a rotation speed of 1500 rpm, a feed rate of 0.15 mm/rev, and a high-speed steel (HSS) tool.

The Wire EDM Cutting operation, performed on a Wire EDM (Electrical Discharge Machine) for 42 minutes with electrical parameters set to 50 V and 10 A, uses a brass wire to cut a Shaped Part from the conveyor belt at a speed of 5 mm/min, producing a Precision Finished Part which is then placed back onto the conveyor belt.

Using a Gear Shaper, the Broached Component from the conveyor belt undergoes Gear Shaping for 99 minutes to produce a Shaped Gear with a Spur gear type, 30 teeth, and a shaping speed of 10 strokes per minute, which is then placed on the conveyor belt.

The hobbing operation, performed on a hobbing machine for 7 minutes at a speed of 100 rpm and a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev, transforms a broached component into a hobbied gear with an involute profile, with both the input and output being handled by a mobile robot.

The Punch Press performs a Punching operation on Sheet Metal using a 5 mm punch, a stroke speed of 50 strokes/min, and a die alignment of 0.02 mm for 18 minutes, transforming it into a Finished Sheet Metal Product.

The Drilling operation uses a Drill Press for 23 minutes to transform a Metal Bar into a Drilled Component by drilling with an 8 mm drill bit at a spindle speed of 1000 rpm and a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev.
The Vertical Milling Machine performs milling on a Lathed Part for 12 minutes at a speed of 500 rpm using an End Mill with a depth of cut of 5 mm, transforming it into a Milled Part.

Using a Planer, the Milled Part from the Conveyor Belt is processed through Planing for 87 minutes with a Planing depth of 2 mm, a Feed rate of 0.05 mm/pass, and achieving a Surface finish of 0.8 µm, resulting in the Planed Part being placed back onto the Conveyor Belt.

The 'Milling' operation transforms the 'Milled Part' into a 'Finished Machined Component' using a Horizontal Milling Machine for 86 minutes, operating at a milling speed of 600 rpm with a preloaded tool path to achieve a surface finish of 0.4 µm, with both input and output components handled by a MobileRobot.

The bandsaw performs a sawing operation on a metal bar from the conveyor belt for 13 minutes at a speed of 50 m/min using a bimetal blade with a 2 mm cutting width, producing a lathed part placed back on the conveyor belt.
The Screw Machines perform Threading on a Lathed Part for 66 minutes to produce a Screwed Component, using an M6 screw size, Metric thread type, and a production rate of 100 units per hour.

Using a Hobbing Machine for 67 minutes, the operation of Gear Hobbing transforms a Broached Gear Blank from the ConveyorBelt into a Hobbied Gear loaded onto a MobileRobot, with key parameters set to a hobbing speed of 150 rpm, a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev, and an involute gear profile.

The Precision Grinding operation, performed on a Grinding Machine for 2 minutes using an Aluminum Oxide grinding wheel at a wheel speed of 30 m/s and a feed rate of 0.05 mm/pass, transforms a Planed Shaft from the ConveyorBelt into a Ground Shaft placed on a MobileRobot.

Using a Wire EDM (Electrical Discharge Machine) for Wire EDM Finishing, a Shaped Gear from the conveyor belt is precisely cut into a Precision Gear at 2 mm/min with 220 V and 10 A electrical parameters using a brass wire, completing the operation in 69 minutes and transferring the output to a mobile robot.

Using a Vertical Lathe, a Steel Bar from the Conveyor Belt undergoes Vertical Turning for 87 minutes at a rotation speed of 800 rpm, a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev, and with Carbide Inserts to produce a Lathed Shaft, which is then placed on a Mobile Robot.

The Horizontal Milling Machine performs Horizontal Milling on a Milled Gear taken from the ConveyorBelt to produce a Finished Gear, using a milling speed of 1000 rpm, a contour tool path, and achieving a surface finish of 0.8 Ra, and this operation takes 56 minutes before the Finished Gear is placed on a MobileRobot.

The CNC Turning Center performs CNC Turning, transforming a Lathed Shaft from the ConveyorBelt into a Finished Shaft placed on a MobileRobot, using a Custom G-code program, 0.1 mm tool offsets, and a spindle speed of 1200 rpm, for 22 minutes.

Laser Cutting is performed on the Laser Cutter for 24 minutes using a 2 kW laser at a cutting speed of 0.5 m/min with nitrogen gas assist to transform a Steel Sheet from the ConveyorBelt into a Cut Steel Sheet placed on a MobileRobot.

The Stewart Platform Mills perform Precision Milling for 67 minutes, using an End Mill with active vibration damping to achieve a milling precision of 0.01 mm, transforming a Milled Gear Shaft from the ConveyorBelt into a Ground Gear Shaft placed on a MobileRobot.

Using a Drill Press, drill a 10 mm hole in a Steel Bar located on a ConveyorBelt with a spindle speed of 500 rpm and a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev for 60 minutes to produce a Drilled Shaft, which is then placed on a MobileRobot.

The Broaching Machine performs an internal broaching operation on a Steel Bar for 7 minutes, using a feed rate of 0.05 mm/pass and a depth of cut of 0.2 mm, to transform it into a Broached Gear Blank, which is then placed on a MobileRobot.

Using a Vertical Milling Machine for 2 minutes with a milling speed of 1500 rpm, an end mill tool, and a depth of cut of 0.5 mm, the lathed shaft from the conveyor belt is vertically milled to produce the milled shaft, which is then placed on the mobile robot.

The Screw Machines perform Threading operation for 71 minutes, using an M12 screw size and a Metric thread type at a production rate of 10 parts/min, transforming Lathed Shafts from the ConveyorBelt into Screwed Shafts loaded onto a MobileRobot.

The Gear Shaper machine performs the Gear Shaping operation on a Broached Gear Blank from the ConveyorBelt, producing a Spur-type Shaped Gear with 24 teeth at a shaping speed of 20 strokes/min for 63 minutes, then places the finished gear onto a MobileRobot.

The Shaper machine performs the Shaping operation on a Milled Gear from the ConveyorBelt to produce a Shaped Gear, using a High-Speed Steel tool with a stroke length of 50 mm and a shaping speed of 15 strokes/min, for 63 minutes, and transfers the output to a MobileRobot.

The Honing operation is performed on the Honing Machine for 99 minutes, using a 400 grit size and a 30 s cycle time, to transform a Cylindrical Shaft from the ConveyorBelt into a Precision Shaft with a 50 mm bore size, which is then placed on a MobileRobot.

The Punch Press performs the Punching operation for 79 minutes, using a 12 mm punch at a stroke speed of 60 strokes/min with high-precision die alignment, to transform a steel sheet from the conveyor belt into a finished steel plate placed on a mobile robot.

The Horizontal Lathe performs Horizontal Turning on a Steel Bar using a rotation speed of 1000 rpm, a feed rate of 0.15 mm/rev, and carbide inserts as the tool type for 84 minutes, transforming it into a Lathed Shaft.
